links.outcome: AI triage performance across age, gender, and ethnic subgroups
links.effect: Consistently high accuracy across age groups (Young, Adult, Senior), genders, and ethnicities (Chinese, Malay, Indian, Others), with sensitivity, specificity, and AUC consistently above 84%.
links.quote: Subgroup analysis revealed consistently high accuracy across various age groups (Young, Adult, Senior), genders, and ethnicities (Chinese, Malay, Indian, Others), with sensitivity, specificity, and AUC consistently above 84%.

screen.reason: Prospective clinical evaluation of a commercial CXR AI triaging system (Lunit INSIGHT CXR Triage) measuring diagnostic accuracy and turnaround time across demographic subgroups, without comparing a specific organizational safeguard or deployment practice.
